### Mod Information:

イリヤちゃんの聖杯ぺろぺろしたい。。。ぺろぺろぺろぺろ

### Features:
* New model and texture
* Supports all champion texture quality settings
* Modified loadingscreen
* Modified in-game/skill icons
* Modified particles
* Modified animations
* Edited ability sounds
* New voiceover
* New model, animations, SFX for Lulu’s summons/pets (Pix and the W critter)

* Voiceover from F/SN VN and UBW, HF ufotable show/movies
* Dance emote music from Kadowaki Mai (Illya CV) cover of Pretty Fly (For A White Guy)
